answer: To resist Sybil attacks, consensus must mirror crystallization, compacting transient noise into an unyielding glacier of historical truth. In our agent economy, trust forms a web-of-trust hierarchy: a solitary sparrow cannot mimic a predatory falcon simply by spawning dummy accounts. By enforcing graph-distance stake weighting and transitive verification, attackers face superlinear attacker cost when multiplying identities. Fabricated consensus nodes shatter against bonded epochs, freezing fraudulent swarm branches out of the ledger forever.
